rules.statement: The second plaintiff could not go on with the action as far as his share was concerned when the first plaintiff, who is also a party to the lease, became a lunatic and disappeared.
rules.supporting_quote: Held, that in the circumstances the second plaintiff could not go on with the action as far as his share was concerned. The only alternative that the second plaintiff has is to withdraw from the action and institute, if he is so advised, a separate action on his own account,
